Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Northstar's procurement asked us to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can hit a late-October integration target. Two quick asks from our side to scope the MAP:

1) SOC 2: we need confirmation of Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report and the period covered.
2) SIG/CAIQ: our security team will share a CAIQ-style questionnaire and expects an initial pass-back within 7 business days.
3) DPA: we'd like a copy of your current DPA; we'll circulate redlines if needed.
4) Data retention and residency: specify retention tiers (logs, model outputs, customer PII), and whether EU residency is available for backups.

Can you propose a short MAP with milestones (evidence delivery, SIG pass, DPA sign) and target dates? We want to lock procurement terms with Legal by Oct 12.

- 2028-09-18: DPA v2 uploaded to DocuSign (Redwood deliverable)
- 2028-09-25: Final signatures and procurement confirmation (target)
- 2028-10-02: Staging POC kickoff

Action items: Jonas/Kimberly to upload v2 of the DPA to DocuSign by 9/18; Grace to share Drive evidence link now (done). Rajat — if Northstar needs model output retention set at 180 days we can add that to the SOW; let us know by 9/15.
